scope: Material-only Seawall actor overrides for existing underpass concrete and city building masses.
licence: Original procedural shader detail; existing source attribution is retained by the source manifests. No photograph, facade artwork, logo, interior or sign is copied.
source_limits: Building geometry, position, source material class and color come from the existing source manifests.
Window bays, floor bands, concrete joints and weathering are visual estimates. They are not measured facade surveys or evidence of present conditions.
Original roofs, skyline sails and route pavement receive no new facade pattern.
Distant detail fades out by 700 m. This pass adds no mesh, texture, light, interior, displacement or collision.
The authorized image review must assess visual quality after import. Source checks do not establish visual acceptance.
